title: Uzbekistan Tax Committee denies claim that circulating data came from a breach of its systems
summary: UzDaily reports that data circulating on social media and Telegram channels was presented as coming from a breach of the Tax Committee's systems. The committee's press service says its specialists found no signs of unauthorised access to its infrastructure, and that the case was linked to the infrastructure of one online cash register operator. It says it is assessing that operator's compliance with security requirements.
plain: Data allegedly from Uzbekistan's Tax Committee spread online. The committee says its own systems were not accessed and ties the case to an online cash register operator.
exec: A tax authority denies a breach of its systems; the committee links the case to a cash register operator's infrastructure.

validation.note: Only UzDaily read; the committee's statement is as relayed by UzDaily. The article does not name who made the claim.

review.note: exec wording stronger than source; now says committee links case to operator
